jobs.description:
Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• Preferably you have a master's or bachelor’s degree in IT

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Are you an experienced Data Engineer who thrives in the ever-changing world of Information Technology? Then we have exciting opportunities for you!

We are looking for multiple freelance professionals for different projects. Your personal passion, interests and experience will be decisive in setting the right accents and determining your personal journey.

Your job responsibilities:

• Have experience in one or more of the following: data modelling, data warehousing, databases, ETL/ELT. Experience in data warehouse automation is considered as a plus.
• Knowledge of advanced data analysis tools and programming languages such as Python, R, SQL, or Java. Strong knowledge of PowerBI & Databricks are a must.
• You can turn the organisation's data into impactful reporting and clear insights that provide interpretation and lead to business process improvements.
• Creating data mappings, implementing standards, clean up data and implementing reference datasets.
• Deep experience applying advanced analytics to a variety of business situations and a proven ability to synthesize complex data, as well as a deep understanding of modern machine learning techniques and their mathematical underpinnings, and the ability to translate this into business implications for our clients.
 

Your Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Business engineering, business management or equivalent experience (5+ years).
• Dutch or French speaking with a strong knowledge of English.
• You are located in Belgium & able to work on-site/remote depending on the client’s needs.
You will work at a variety of large enterprises depending on your interest and your preferred way of working. At Brainbridge we cover the IT landscape from A to Z.

Help Keep Europe Moving
 

At Sally Europe, we're passionate about inspiring a more colourful, confident, and welcoming world. Behind every product on our shelves is a team of experts ensuring the right products are available at the right time, in the right place.
 

We're looking for a highly analytical and commercially aware 
Supply Planner to join our European Supply Chain team. If you enjoy turning data into action, collaborating across multiple functions, and solving complex supply challenges, we'd love to hear from you.
 

What You'll Do
 
 

• Manage inventory levels to support customer demand while minimising excess stock. 

• Create and maintain supply forecasts using sales data, trends, and promotional plans. 

• Manage purchasing and intake plans within agreed budgets. 

• Support product launches, promotions, and range changes to ensure stock is available when needed. 

• Monitor supply chain performance and provide insights to drive improvements. 

• Build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders to proactively manage risks and resolve issues.  

What We're Looking For
 
 

• Experience in Supply Chain, Supply Planning, Demand Planning, Inventory Management, or a similar role. 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with advanced Excel capability. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

• Degree-level education or equivalent experience. 

• Fluency in Dutch and English 

• Experience with forecasting or ERP systems such as D365 is desirable  

Why You'll Love It Here
 

At Sally Europe, we live by our values: Be Yourself. Be Bold. Be An Owner. Be An Inspiration. Be Part of Something Bigger.
 

We believe that when people feel empowered to be themselves, they do their best work. We’ll support you to grow, challenge the norm, and help shape the future of our people operations.
 

We welcome applications from everyone and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated. As part of our culture to 'add colour to the world,' we ensure fair treatment for all, regardless of age, disability, gender, marital status, pregnancy, race, religion, or sexual orientation.
 

Apply today and help keep our supply chain moving.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager IT
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player operating in the retail and distribution sector, with a strong presence in multiple markets. The company provides a wide range of products and services to both professional and private customers, supported by an extensive network and a strong focus on customer experience.

As part of the IT organization, you will play a key role in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming business processes across Supply Chain and Finance domains. Acting as a strategic business partner, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate business needs into sustainable IT solutions.

• Analyze end-to-end business processes, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance, and identify opportunities for optimization and efficiency gains.
• Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements, and design improved processes.
• Translate business needs into pragmatic, scalable, and sustainable SAP-based solutions.
• Challenge business requirements by proposing alternatives aligned with industry best practices and standard solutions.
• Lead or contribute to functional design activities, testing phases, implementation projects, and change initiatives.
• Coordinate collaboration between business teams, IT teams, SAP experts, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
• Ensure consistency and integration across SAP modules and business processes.
• Support issue resolution by providing functional expertise and a strong understanding of business impacts.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the evolution of the application landscape.
• Participate in roadmap definition and transformation programs, from analysis through implementation.
• Take ownership of projects or workstreams, ensuring effective planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery.

Profile

• 5 to 10 years of experience in a Senior Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, SAP Functional Analyst, or similar role.
• Proven experience working on SAP-related projects, with strong knowledge of Supply Chain and/or Finance processes.
• Good understanding of end-to-end business processes, ideally within a retail, distribution, or complex operational environment.
• Ability to quickly understand business challenges and translate them into effective solutions.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure complex topics and provide clear recommendations.
• Experience managing projects, coordinating stakeholders, and driving delivery is a strong asset.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with both business and technical audiences.
• Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on business value and results.
• Proactive, autonomous, and comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is considered an advantage.
• Open-minded, collaborative, and motivated by change and continuous improvement.

Are you ready to help shape and secure the global network that keeps Lotus Bakeries connected across 4 continents?
 

As a Network & Security Engineer, you’ll play a key role in our international Infrastructure team. You will take ownership of the design, implementation, support and continuous improvement of our global network and security landscape, ensuring that our offices and production sites can rely on a connected, performant and secure environment.
 

Our team manages the IT infrastructure for more than 30 locations and 2000+ users worldwide. Together, we make sure our business can operate safely and efficiently by combining strong network foundations with the right security measures, enabling a resilient and future-proof digital workplace.
 

 
 

About the job
 
 

• You participate in international infrastructure projects and execute network and security-related activities within budget, scope and timing. You play an active role in continuously improving the reliability, performance and security of our global infrastructure. 

• Your activities can range from network changes, connectivity setups and application integrations to implementing and optimizing security controls across our IT environment. You help ensure that our network architecture and security posture evolve alongside the needs of our business and production environments. 

• You take ownership of operational support by monitoring the network and security environment, following up incidents with external partners, and leading 3th level troubleshooting when required. You coordinate connectivity and security-related changes with internal stakeholders and external suppliers in areas such as WAN, firewalls, SD-WAN, cloud services, identity management and certificates. 

• In this role, you combine a hands-on approach with a continuous improvement mindset. You identify risks, propose improvements and contribute to the development of a robust, secure and scalable infrastructure roadmap. 

To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:
 
 

• · 
 A relevant academic background and several years of experience in a similar role within network and/or security engineering. 

• · 
 Good knowledge of firewall technologies, network segmentation, SD-WAN concepts and general network security principles. 

• · 
 Experience with implementing and maintaining security controls in a modern enterprise environment. 

• · 
 A broad understanding of IT infrastructure with hands-on experience in areas such as: Microsoft Windows environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory and certificates, servers, storage and virtualization technologies, IT infrastructure in production environments (OT experience is considered a plus), good knowledge of ITIL processes and the ability to apply them in daily operations, a broad interest in infrastructure and security topics, enabling you to evaluate challenges and define future-proof solutions. 

• · 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners and suppliers. 

• · 
 A proactive, hands-on attitude combined with a flexible mindset and a strong drive for continuous improvement. 

• · 
 Language skills that include Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is considered a plus.

Business Development

• Identify new commercial opportunities across the African market
• Develop new business projects while strengthening the company's position in existing markets
• Initiate new partnerships and closely monitor ongoing projects to ensure successful execution
• Act as the main point of contact for all commercial activities within your assigned region

• Drive sustainable business growth and contribute to the continued expansion of the organization

In this role, you are responsible for managing, analyzing, and interpreting the entire range of TradeMarks products as well as several Private Labels in our Product Cataloguing systems. You will keep the product data and cataloguing data of our own brands and private label product data up-to-date and consistent in various databases (e.g., LIS, PIM, ADMIN, TecDoc, X-checker, etc.). Analyzing data across different systems to identify and correct discrepancies and inconsistencies. This work is primarily done using Excel.

 

Responsibilities:

• You assist in optimizing cataloguing processes and data flows. You ensure that data efficiently and accurately flows from our internal systems to various other systems such as websites, platforms, customer portals, etc.
• You support various data update processes and always do so within the agreed timelines.
• You ensure top-quality cataloguing product data, which adds value for our customers.
• You configure data into the formats desired by customers and the various digital formats used in automotive industry catalogues.
• You support both the Product and Marketing teams with analyses and overviews of the cataloguing product data.
• Additionally, you play a crucial role in developing and implementing data management processes and procedures to ensure data quality and accuracy.
• You work closely with the managers of the various databases and other colleagues on data and database optimization and maintenance. You take action where necessary.
• You serve as a backup for the product data specialists.
• 
Moreover, you will have the opportunity to grow in your role and take responsibility for (sub)projects within the Product Cataloguing processes

 

Job Requirements:

• You have at least a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• You have some experience in Data Management (1-5 years), preferably in the Automotive and/or Chemical sector.
• You possess excellent computer skills:
• Excel: advanced (knowledge of pivots, vlookups, concatenates, comparing different data files, etc.)
• Access DB: basic, i.e., loading tables (manually or via import), basic queries, etc.
• Knowledge of cataloguing data systems is an advantage: PIM, TecDoc, X-checker.
• You speak and write fluent Dutch and English. Any other language is a plus.
• You are interested in quality product information, have a keen eye for detail, and work very accurately. You are also eager to continuously expand your knowledge.
• You prefer a structured approach to task follow-up and are capable of working independently. At the same time, you are a team player who relies on and draws upon the expertise of colleagues to help you in your daily tasks.
• You possess good and detailed analytical skills. You are able to work with data from different sources that are not 100% identical and find ways to link this data from various sources.
• You can set priorities, enabling you to consistently achieve the set objectives and deadlines.
• 
Additionally, you are an innovative thinker, always looking for improvements and opportunities in the market. Your organizational skills allow you to effectively manage projects and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
